book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Abram ane Lot Splitap, go demtu ounwei
Abram ane oman blo em bin teke ebrisamting blo demtu kamaut prom Izipt ane lego go po sautsaid pat blo Kanan. Lot i bin go wea demtu tu.
Wa, Abram i bin prapa risman. Em bin gad plenti sip, gout, buluk, ane prapa tumas silba ane gold.

Den Abram i bin libe sautsaid pat blo Kanan ane em bin go stap wea ol dipren dipren ples, bat em kip mub go antil em bin kam po taun blo Betel. Em bin kesem wea da ples melen wea demtu taun Betel ane Ai wea em bin stap de pas.
Diswan ya i da seim ples wea em bin pinis meke olta. Ya gen Abram bin tok po da AntapGod ane wosip em.
Lot em i bin go lo Abram. Demtu bin gad plenti ol sip, gout, buluk, pamle blo demtu ane ol sebant blo demtu.
I no bin gad nap lan po demtu po stap klostu wananada bikoz demtu i bin gad mina plenti animal.

Ane dem man uda bin lugaut ebri animal blo Abram ane dem man uda bin lugaut ebri animal blo Lot, dempla ebriwan bin graul gense wananada. Wea dat seimtaim, dem pipol blo Kanan ane dem pipol blo Perez i bin stap wea da seim lan.
Den Abram i bin spik po Lot, ‘Yumi wan pamle, ane ol wokman blo yumi ol i no spostu graul.
I gad plenti lan ya po yumi. Suzem wanem lan yu wandem ane yumi go splitem. Ip yu teke da lan de nadasaid den ai go teke dis lan ya, bat ip yu teke dis lan ya ai go teke da lan de nadasaid.’
Lot bin lukraun ane em bin luk big platples lo tu said blo Zodan Riba wea i gad prapa gud graun ane plenti wata. Dis ples bin kipgo antil i kese taun blo Zoa. Dis ples i wase da gadan blo da AntapGod
ane wase da big platples blo da Nail Riba lo kantri blo Izipt. Dis ples i bin gud pas, bipo da AntapGod i bin tekemaute laip prom ebri laipsamting blo tu taun blo Sodom ane Gomora.

Lot bin meke main blo em po stap wea da big bali lo tu said blo Zodan Riba wea i gad prapa gud graun ane plenti wata. Em bin mub go libe da ples go istsaid blo da riba. Diswan i wiskain da tu man bin splitap.
Abram bin stap wea da ples blo Kanan bat Lot i bin mub ane go stap klostu po Sodom. Sodom i bin wea dem nada taun lo da platples wea tu said blo Zodan Riba.
Wa, dem pipol blo Sodom i ebritaim meke ol prapa nugud samting ane ol prapa badting gense da AntapGod.
Da taim apta wen Lot ane Abram demtu bin splitap, da AntapGod i bin spik po Abram, ‘Prom wea yu stanap, luk go ebriwea po ebri ples wea yu ken lukem.
Ai go gibe yu ane pamlelain blo yu, ebridem lan wea ai blo yu i kesem. Dis lan i gobi blo yu ane pamlelain blo yu poeba.
Ai go meke pamlelain blo yu prapa plenti solong nobodi i ken kaunte dempla. I go gad mo dempla den dast wea ert.
I taim nau po wagbaut ane lukraun ebriwea lo dis lan bikoz ai go gibem po yu.’
So, Abram ane pamle blo em bin mub go stap klostu po da ples wea dem spesil bigtri blo wan man neim Mamre. Diswan klostu wea taun blo Ebron. De Abram bin bilde nada olta po wosip da AntapGod.

footnotes.text: Gadan blo da AntapGod i wase da gadan blo Iden.
